new_proof_gaps.title: Reference distributions for nested-model deviance tests
new_proof_gaps.reason: The likelihood cancellation and numerical statistics are derived. The regular likelihood-ratio chi-squared limit and exact Gaussian F calibration additionally need asymptotic likelihood theory and independent Gaussian quadratic-form proofs.

new_proof_gaps.title: Independent chi-squared components of a normal one-way ANOVA
new_proof_gaps.reason: The exact algebraic decomposition is proved. Distributional calibration requires a separate proof of the independent normal quadratic-form laws.

new_proof_gaps.title: One-step likelihood equivalence and regular efficiency bound
new_proof_gaps.reason: The score-root normal limit is derived; one-step equivalence requires a uniform local score expansion, and the efficiency lower bound requires a specified regular local estimator class and its own proof.

new_proof_gaps.title: Universal weak consistency of Euclidean k-nearest-neighbour classification
new_proof_gaps.reason: The plug-in risk bound and finite-feature case are proved; the general Euclidean theorem additionally needs Stone’s geometric locality argument.

new_proof_gaps.title: False-discovery control under dependent p-values
new_proof_gaps.reason: The independent-p-value step-up guarantee has a complete leave-one-out proof. Positive-regression-dependence and arbitrary-dependence harmonic-correction extensions require their separate dependence arguments.

new_proof_gaps.title: Multinomial central limit theorem
new_proof_gaps.reason: The finite-count moment identities are derived from category indicators; the general vector central limit theorem requires a separate proof.

new_proof_gaps.title: Grouped multinomial efficient-fit linearization
new_proof_gaps.reason: Projection geometry is derived conditional on the score linearization; a full regularity-based derivation of the fitted residual expansion remains.

new_proof_gaps.title: Conditional Gaussian laws with singular conditioning covariance
new_proof_gaps.reason: The independent-residual decomposition proves the nonsingular conditioning formula, including a degenerate residual. The singular conditioning extension requires a support and generalised-inverse construction.

new_proof_gaps.title: Strong law and central limit theorem for iid increments
new_proof_gaps.reason: Moment identities are derived; general limit theorems are used as dependencies with finite absolute mean or finite positive variance and need full standalone proofs.

new_proof_gaps.title: High-dimensional graphical EBIC consistency
new_proof_gaps.reason: The score and a finite-model comparison are derived, but the uniform likelihood bounds and decomposable-graph consistency proof in Foygel–Drton require a separate treatment.

new_proof_gaps.title: Asymptotic chi-squared calibration under independence and homogeneity
new_proof_gaps.reason: Likelihood fitting and parameter counts are derived. A full multivariate limit argument for Pearson calibration under each sampling design remains to be supplied.

new_proof_gaps.title: General existence in the Lebesgue decomposition theorem
new_proof_gaps.reason: Uniqueness, countability of atoms and the Cantor construction are proved. The general existence construction for arbitrary sigma-finite measures uses the cited measure decomposition theorem and requires a separate Radon–Nikodym argument.

new_proof_gaps.title: Markov-property equivalence and Hammersley–Clifford converse
new_proof_gaps.reason: The finite discrete factorization-to-global implication is derived; the positive-density converse and the full conditional-independence axioms require a measure-theoretic proof.

new_proof_gaps.title: General existence of a constrained Gaussian maximum-likelihood fit
new_proof_gaps.reason: The score equations, strict concavity and finite chain example are derived. The general positive-definite completion existence theorem and graph-dependent existence conditions for singular sample covariances require a separate proof.

new_proof_gaps.title: Regularity sufficient for the score expansion
new_proof_gaps.reason: The asymptotic covariance is derived conditional on a valid local expansion; a full uniform differentiability and stochastic equicontinuity proof is needed for general models.

new_proof_gaps.title: Multiplicative-update descent for nonnegative matrix factorization
new_proof_gaps.reason: The numerical example checks one alternating update and the algebra establishes scale/permutation invariance. The cited auxiliary-function descent theorem for general positive matrices requires a complete auxiliary-function proof.

new_proof_gaps.title: Exact multivariate Hotelling F calibration
new_proof_gaps.reason: The local proof verifies affine invariance and the p=1 reduction. A complete derivation of the independent normal/Wishart quadratic-form ratio giving F_{p,n-p} for general p remains to be supplied.

new_proof_gaps.title: Uniform density of continuous sigmoidal ridge sums
new_proof_gaps.reason: The window calculations verify a finite construction. A complete density proof needs the separating-measure and Fourier-uniqueness steps of Cybenko Theorem 1 and Lemma 1.

new_proof_gaps.title: Regular fixed-dimensional sufficiency characterisation
new_proof_gaps.reason: The exponential-family factorisation direction and the moving-support counterexample are derived. A complete proof of a general fixed-dimensional converse, with an explicit matching set of regularity hypotheses, remains to be supplied.

new_proof_gaps.title: General consistency under coordinate-rank neighbour metrics
new_proof_gaps.reason: The rank invariance and finite examples are derived directly. The general nearest-neighbour consistency result cited to Biau and Devroye, Remark8.2 and Theorem11.1, requires a separate asymptotic proof and its sampling and weighting assumptions.

new_proof_gaps.title: Monotone convergence for nonnegative expectation
new_proof_gaps.reason: The general interchange of an increasing limit and the integral establishes independence of the simple approximation; the finite partition argument and uniform-grid example establish their narrower claims.

new_proof_gaps.title: Finite-sample Hotelling ellipsoid coverage
new_proof_gaps.reason: The all-direction projection and its sharpness are derived; exact normal-model F calibration of the starting ellipsoid requires the inverse-Wishart quadratic-form law.

new_proof_gaps.title: Null calibration for adding a correlated subject slope
new_proof_gaps.reason: The Gaussian mixed likelihood is refitted and its likelihood-ratio statistic recomputed. Exact finite-sample calibration when the slope variance and its covariance vanish on the null boundary remains a separate inference problem.

new_proof_gaps.title: Natural cubic variational characterisation of the smoothing-spline minimiser
new_proof_gaps.reason: The finite basis smoothness and penalty example are verified algebraically. A full calculus-of-variations proof of existence and the natural cubic minimiser for the stated function-space optimisation is deferred.

new_proof_gaps.title: Gaussian factorial ANOVA F calibration
new_proof_gaps.reason: Cell means, coding identities, sums of squares and numerical F-tail calculations are derived and recomputed; exact F calibration requires orthogonal Gaussian projection and common-variance assumptions.

new_proof_gaps.title: Exact normal-sample Hotelling–F law
new_proof_gaps.reason: The fixed-dimension chi-squared limit is derived, but the exact Wishart and normal-independence derivation of the finite-sample F transformation is a separate result.

new_proof_gaps.title: Sandwich covariance consistency for marginal estimating equations
new_proof_gaps.reason: The covariance identities and finite examples are recomputed. The general asymptotic consistency and normality statements of Liang and Zeger (1986), Theorems1–2, require their regularity and independent-unit conditions and a separate limiting argument.

new_proof_gaps.title: Normal–Wishart quadratic-form F law
new_proof_gaps.reason: Gaussian projection supplies the pooled Wishart distribution and independence, but its inverse quadratic-form F calibration needs a full distributional derivation.

new_proof_gaps.title: Modified Wishart moment approximation
new_proof_gaps.reason: The trace-based effective degrees of freedom and its scalar reduction are stated and checked; accuracy of the general multivariate approximation needs its separate moment calculation and assessment.

new_proof_gaps.title: Finite irreducible continuous-time chain convergence
new_proof_gaps.reason: The finite Poisson-mixture construction and its two-state computation are derived; convergence of every finite irreducible chain to its unique stationary distribution requires a separate general argument.

new_proof_gaps.title: Exact multivariate Hotelling calibration
new_proof_gaps.reason: The scalar normal/chi-squared ratio is derived, while the general inverse-Wishart quadratic-form F law requires a separate distributional proof.

new_proof_gaps.title: Continuous-sigmoid density theorem
new_proof_gaps.reason: The general density result requires a separation and signed-measure argument; the explicit ReLU interpolation proof covers only its stated target and domain.

new_proof_gaps.title: General radius–margin shattering bound
new_proof_gaps.reason: The restricted shattering statement and convention conversion are verified against Burges §7.1 Theorem6. A complete proof of the geometric simplex extremum lemma and its application to all dimensions remains to be supplied.

new_proof_gaps.title: GEE consistency and sandwich covariance
new_proof_gaps.reason: The mean-zero estimating-equation argument is given, but the independent-cluster law of large numbers, derivative convergence and central limit theorem needed for full GEE asymptotics remain to be developed.

new_proof_gaps.title: GEE cluster-asymptotic consistency and sandwich calibration
new_proof_gaps.reason: The general theorem requires a law of large numbers and central limit theorem over independent clusters; the two-label numerical demonstration does not establish its asymptotic conclusions.

new_proof_gaps.title: Regular local quadratic likelihood expansion
new_proof_gaps.reason: The Gaussian projection argument is supplied conditional on a uniform local quadratic expansion and localisation of both maximisers; a full proof of those regular asymptotic ingredients remains.

The figure is preserved without claiming a new simulation or independent empirical verification.
